hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == lib/**/*.dart ]]; then flutter format "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | head -5; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == lib/**/*.dart ]]; then flutter format "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | head -5; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == lib/**/*.dart ]]; then flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | head -10; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == services/api-backend/**/*.js ]]; then cd services/api-backend && npm run format 2>&1 | head -5; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == services/api-backend/**/*.js ]]; then cd services/api-backend && npm run format 2>&1 | head -5; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == test/**/*.dart ]]; then flutter test "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" --reporter expanded 2>&1 | tail -20; fi

if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '(lib/(auth|payment|tunnel|database|ssh)|services/api-backend/(auth|payment|tunnel|database))'; then echo '⚠️  Security-sensitive files changed. Consider running /security-reviewer before committing.'; fi
